$playerKey..validate: !newData.exists() || (newData.hasChildren(['schemaVersion', 'playerKey', 'playerName', 'party', 'updatedAt', 'updatedByUid']) && (newData.child('schemaVersion').val() == 1 || newData.child('schemaVersion').val() == 2) && newData.child('playerKey').val() == $playerKey && newData.child('playerName').isString() && newData.child('playerName').val().length > 0 && newData.child('playerName').val().length <= 20 && newData.child('party').numChildren() == 6 && newData.child('updatedAt').isNumber() && newData.child('updatedByUid').val() == auth.uid)

$index..validate: $index.matches(/^[0-5]$/) && newData.hasChildren(['speciesId', 'level', 'natureId', 'abilityId', 'moveIds', 'ivs']) && (newData.child('effortPoints').numChildren() == 6 || newData.child('evs').numChildren() == 6) && newData.child('speciesId').isString() && newData.child('level').isNumber() && newData.child('moveIds').numChildren() >= 1 && newData.child('moveIds').numChildren() <= 4 && newData.child('ivs').numChildren() == 6

effortPoints..validate: !newData.exists() || (newData.hasChildren(['hp', 'attack', 'defense', 'specialAttack', 'specialDefense', 'speed']) && newData.numChildren() == 6 && newData.child('hp').val() + newData.child('attack').val() + newData.child('defense').val() + newData.child('specialAttack').val() + newData.child('specialDefense').val() + newData.child('speed').val() <= 66)
